versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated runtime/run.mjs with minor adjustments.
- No changes to user workflow or feature set.

- Improved internal runtime documentation in references/runtime.md.
- Refined runtime logic in run.mjs and yaps-cli-discovery.mjs.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of yaps-video-to-audio.
- Extracts audio from video files as MP3, WAV, or M4A using Yaps (v2.3.124+).
- Workflow includes file selection, format choice, extraction, and result validation.
- Handles errors for missing audio or media dependencies.
- Does not include transcription, denoising, or scene editing functions.
